question: In a dihybrid cross between two heterozygous fruit flies with brown bodies and red eyes (BbEe X BbEe), what will be the probability of getting BBEE genotype?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1/16**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The probability of getting a BBEE genotype in a dihybrid cross between two heterozygous fruit flies (BbEe X BbEe) is **1/16**.
 
• Each parent can produce four types of gametes: BE, Be, bE, and be, with equal probability (1/4 each).
